subject: math
about: Misprints in the NaCCA Mathematics PDFs (B1 to B3 = m13, B4 to B6 = m46) and what the curriculum parser does about each. The corrected code is canonical. The printed code is kept as an alias only when 'alias' is true, which is never the case when another indicator really owns the printed code. 'occurrence' counts uses of the printed code within one document. 'page' is the position of the page in the PDF file (not the number printed at the foot of the page). Draft files under data/contexts/drafts/ are keyed by the printed code: map their keys with 'draft_keys' (or kwan.curriculum.corrections.draft_key_map()); a key that is not listed is already canonical or is an alias.

actions.recode: the statement is a real indicator; its canonical code is 'corrected'
actions.merge: the statement repeats the indicator 'corrected' (duplicated page); its exemplars are merged into that indicator
actions.drop_heading: the line is not an indicator; the text under it stays with the indicator that the page continues

corrections.source: raw/m46.txt line 5133; m46.pdf page 165 (first use: line 5109, page 164)
corrections.reason: The code B6.3.3.5.1 is printed for two different indicators. The first (page 164, compass directions) keeps it. The second (page 165, performing a reflection or translation) starts a NEW content-standard cell: from page 165 the left column prints a different standard statement (about performing a single transformation), still under the code B6.3.3.5. So the document has two content standards here and the code of the second is a misprint. Basic 5 has the same pair as two consecutive standards (B5.3.4.1 compass directions, B5.3.4.2 transformations). The second standard therefore takes the next free number in the sub-strand, B6.3.3.6, and its two indicators keep their printed indicator numbers: .1 and .2. No alias, because B6.3.3.5.1 belongs to the first indicator. This is a Kwan decision from position; NaCCA prints no code for it.

Second indicator of the transformation standard described in the entry above (the left column beside it prints the transformation standard). It moves with its standard to B6.3.3.6 so that the two transformation indicators stay together and in order. The printed code B6.3.3.5.2 stays as an alias.
A four-part misprint. It sits beside content standard B6.4.1.2, between B6.4.1.2.1 (page 172) and B6.4.1.2.3 (page 175). No alias: the printed form is not a five-part indicator code.
First letter misprinted (P for B). It sits beside content standard B6.4.2.2, after B6.4.2.2.2.

sub_strand_names_about: Sub-strand names that the PDF does not print cleanly. B4.1.4, B4.1.5, B5.1.4 and B5.1.5 have no sub-strand heading at all in m46.pdf (the decimals and percentage standards follow the fractions pages without a heading), so Kwan names them. B4.3.3 has two headings ('Measurement- (Perimeter and Area)' on page 57 and 'Measurement -Time' on page 61) for one sub-strand number, so Kwan joins them. Every other name is the heading printed in the PDF, or, where a grade prints no heading (B2.1.2, B5.1.2, B6.3.1), the heading of the same sub-strand in the nearest grade.
